name: Accenture
title: 8-K · NEWS RELEASE OF ACCENTURE, DATED JUNE 18, 2026

read.thesis: Q3 FY26 revenue +3% LC with bookings down 3% LC and FY26 LC growth guide trimmed to 3-4% from 3-5%; supply-side signals are soft, not disciplined, and margins held by cost cuts.

triggers.label: LC growth guide cut to 3-4%
triggers.quote: Company now expects full-year revenue growth to be 3% to 4% in local currency

triggers.label: Bookings down 3% LC in Q3
triggers.quote: a decrease of 2% in U.S. dollars and 3% in local currency compared to the third quarter of fiscal 2025

triggers.label: OT security acquisitions (Dragos, runZero, NetRise)
triggers.quote: Our agreement to acquire a majority stake in Dragos and all of runZero and NetRise

guidance.value: 3% to 4% (4% to 5% ex US federal ~1% impact)
guidance.quote: Company now expects full-year revenue growth to be 3% to 4% in local currency
Now expects full-year GAAP diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $13.38 to $13.50
now expects full-year adjusted earnings per share to be in the range of $13.78 to $13.90
Continues to expect free cash flow to be in the range of $10.8 billion to $11.5 billion

prior_guidance_check.quote: Company now expects full-year revenue growth to be 3% to 4% in local currency
Continues to expect free cash flow to be in the range of $10.8 billion to $11.5 billion
GAAP Operating Margin * 15.3% 60 bps expansion over FY25

red_flags.label: Bookings down 3% LC; FY26 LC growth guide cut
red_flags.quote: a decrease of 2% in U.S. dollars and 3% in local currency compared to the third quarter of fiscal 2025
